authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2592 Kakṣyā explicitly gives Chiliss kaċ and Maiya kas near, tentatively through a locative kakṣye. Survey kaʦ near fits the affricate series; the proposed locative and ultimate semantic derivation remain qualified. Exact form kaʦ is preserved; possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
